content:
Grace O'Connor: quick sync thread on FinServ target list v1 before we lock tiering + ownership. current sheet: https://drive.google.com/…/abm-finserv-target-account-list-v1 (pls don’t forward externally). Need decisions by EOD so SDRs can start sequence builds tomorrow.

Grace O'Connor: open questions:
1) Tiering: what’s Tier 1 vs Tier 2 vs “watchlist”
2) Contact gaps: which accounts are missing CISO/GRC + Platform Eng contacts
3) Ownership: assign AE + SDR per Tier 1 so outreach isn’t duplicated

Stephanie Nguyen: thx. for NA, I’d rather keep Tier 1 small (8–10) so SE can support deep dives. if we do 20 “Tier 1” it becomes Tier 2 in reality.

Avery Johnson: +1. also some of these look like long-cycle whales. if we’re optimizing for meetings in 6–8 weeks, we should favor teams that can actually pilot hosted->dedicated->private quickly.

Priyom Das: agreed. also I’m seeing a bunch of payments processors in Tier 1. those can move fast but they’re also super picky on audit logs + KMS. fine, but we need the right contacts.

Hannah Schmitt: can someone clarify criteria? is Tier 1 “highest fit” or “highest likelihood to meet now”? not always the same.

Grace O'Connor: proposal:
Tier 1 = best fit + we have a credible path to a meeting in pilot window (contacts exist or are 1 hop away)
Tier 2 = good fit but contact gaps / timing risk
Watchlist = fit uncertain or heavy incumbent lock-in

Diego Fernandez: makes sense. I’d also add “known Private/VPC requirement” as Tier 1 signal. if they’ll accept shared hosted only, we’re not testing the campaign.

Isabelle Laurent: jumping in w/ data note: if we want clean ABM reporting, Tier should map to a single property in HubSpot and not be changed weekly. we can do “Tier” + “Priority rationale” as a note field.

Grace O'Connor: ok. then let’s pick Tier 1 as 10 accounts max for NA for week 1–2, and we can promote from Tier 2 later.

Stephanie Nguyen: Works. top candidates I’d put Tier 1 (NA):
- NorthBridge Bank (already engaged)
- Crescent Wealth (already engaged)
- Harborview Payments (already engaged)
- Ironclad Risk Analytics (regtech, fast movers)
- Meridian Credit Union (new)
- Hightower Brokerage (new)
- RedCedar Capital (new)
- Atlas Card Services (new)

Stephanie Nguyen: that’s 8. we can add 2 more once we confirm contacts.

Avery Johnson: I’m good owning NorthBridge + Crescent.

Priyom Das: I can take Harborview + Atlas Card Services.

Diego Fernandez: I’ll take Ironclad + Meridian CU.

Hannah Schmitt: I can take Hightower + RedCedar.

Grace O'Connor: perfect. SDR pairing suggestion:
Avery <-> Rohan
Priyom <-> (I’ll assign another SDR, but for now Rohan can help w/ contact research)
Diego <-> Rohan (light support)
Hannah <-> Rohan (light support)

Rohan Mehta: lol i’m about to become the universal SDR. :sweat_smile: but yes, can cover contact research + first touches until we split.

Stephanie Nguyen: we should be explicit on “no duplicate outreach”. if Rohan is supporting multiple AEs, we need a single “first touch owner” per account.

Grace O'Connor: yep. for Tier 1, the AE owns the account strategy + final email copy personalization; SDR runs first-touch sequence but only on the accounts they’re paired to. For the ones where Rohan is “light support”, he’ll only do contact research + enrichment, not outbound.

Markus Klein: SE POV: pls keep Tier 1 = accounts that can actually commit to a VPC/private architecture session. I can cover 2–3 deep dives per week max across the team. If we book 10 deep dives in one week, it’ll bottleneck.

Avery Johnson: re: contact gaps — NorthBridge has CISO + Head of Platform in the CRM already. Crescent is missing GRC contact; they mentioned “risk committee” on the call but no names.

Priyom Das: Harborview has VP Infra + Security Eng in notes, but no formal GRC. also missing someone who owns data retention policy (sometimes compliance ops).

Hannah Schmitt: Hightower + RedCedar are basically blank in our CRM (just company shells). we need at least: CISO (or deputy), Head of Platform/Cloud, and someone on ML/Applied AI.

Rohan Mehta: I can pull first-pass contacts via SalesNav today. question: are we prioritizing security persona first or platform persona first for FinServ?

Stephanie Nguyen: security first for this pilot. FinServ will stall on “how do you handle audit logs / KMS / retention” so we need that convo early. but don’t ignore Platform Eng — they’re the ones who can say yes to a VPC deep dive.

Grace O'Connor: +1. Sequence A = security-forward (CISO/GRC), Sequence B = platform-forward (Platform Eng/Infra). Same core story, different opener.

Isabelle Laurent: please log which sequence variant is used per contact (we have a “ABM Sequence Variant” dropdown draft). will help w/ weekly iteration.

Priyom Das: tiering debate: Atlas Card Services — are we sure Tier 1? I see a big incumbent vendor mentioned in notes ("locked into hyperscaler managed endpoints"). That could be a slog.

Diego Fernandez: agree. if they’re all-in on hyperscaler and just price-shopping, we may get dragged into feature comparison hell.

Stephanie Nguyen: counterpoint: payments processors *do* care about latency/cost predictability and sometimes hit hosted limitations fast. if we can lead with Dedicated->Private and auditability, it can be a wedge.

Avery Johnson: can we keep Atlas as Tier 2 until we confirm an internal champion + get at least 2 relevant contacts? otherwise we waste week 1.

Grace O'Connor: ok: Atlas moves to Tier 2 pending contact validation. We’ll pull in one more Tier 1 from Tier 2 list once Rohan confirms contacts.

Priyom Das: works. I’ll still hold ownership on Atlas but won’t outbound until it’s promoted.

Grace O'Connor: who becomes Tier 1 replacement candidate?

Stephanie Nguyen: Meridian CU stays Tier 1. Add “Stonegate Bank” as candidate if we can find CISO + Head of Platform quickly.

Rohan Mehta: I can research Stonegate today. if I find both + emails, we can promote.

Hannah Schmitt: also “RedCedar Capital” — is it actually regulated enough? some asset managers are lighter on controls vs banks.

Stephanie Nguyen: still regulated (SEC/FINRA) + they tend to have strict vendor review. good test case.

Markus Klein: re: contact gaps — if you can’t find a CISO, deputy CISO or Head of GRC works. also “Director of Technology Risk” shows up a lot in FinServ.

Grace O'Connor: action items:
- Rohan: contact research for Tier 1 accounts (NorthBridge, Crescent, Harborview, Ironclad, Meridian CU, Hightower, RedCedar) + Stonegate as potential Tier 1 replacement; add 2–3 personas each (CISO/GRC + Platform + ML).
- AEs: confirm ownership in sheet + add 1–2 bullets on “why now / hypothesis” per Tier 1.
- Isabelle: share the final HubSpot properties we should use for Tier + sequence variant so SDR ops doesn’t guess.

Isabelle Laurent: will do. I’ll drop the property names here once finalized. likely:
- `ABM Pilot Vertical` (FinServ)
- `ABM Tier` (1/2/Watch)
- `ABM Sequence Variant` (Security/Platform)
- `ABM Owner (AE)` + `ABM Owner (SDR)`

Avery Johnson: note: for NorthBridge + Crescent, we should avoid cold sequencing people already engaged. I’ll send targeted follow-ups instead and SDR can focus on adjacent stakeholders.

Grace O'Connor: good call. SDR should run "stakeholder expansion" motion on engaged accounts (new contacts only).

Priyom Das: can we agree on a rule: once an AE has an active thread w/ a stakeholder, SDR doesn’t email that person unless AE asks.

Stephanie Nguyen: yes. add that to the playbook.

Grace O'Connor: added. (reactions: :thumbsup: x5)

Rohan Mehta: updating sheet now w/ contact status columns:
- CISO/GRC found?
- Platform Eng found?
- ML/AI found?
Will mark as ✅ / ⚠️ / ❌ so we can see gaps fast.

Markus Klein: pls also note if account requires on-prem vs VPC. if it’s “must be on-prem day 1” we may want to de-prioritize for pilot.

Diego Fernandez: +1. I’ve seen on-prem only = long procurement + security review.

Grace O'Connor: ok, I’ll add “deployment requirement” column: Hosted ok / VPC required / on-prem required / unknown.

Stephanie Nguyen: timeline reminder: we need Tier 1 list final by tomorrow 10am so we can align in Friday standup.

Grace O'Connor: cool. I’ll post updated Tier 1 + owners in this thread once Rohan finishes contact research.

Rohan Mehta: ETA 2 hours for first pass.

Grace O'Connor: thx. closing loop later today.
